title: Vulnerability digest — 26 Nov 2026, 13:05 CET
markdown:
- **CVE-2026-123903**, VMware VMware vCenter Server, VMware VMware Cloud Foundation, VMware VMware Telco Cloud Platform, VMware VMware Telco Cloud Infrastructure, VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service with a critical severity score of 9.8. Fixes are available in VMware vCenter Server 9.1.2, 9.0.2.0300, 8.0 U3m, VMware Cloud Foundation 5.2.5, and various VMware Telco Cloud Platform versions via KB463501.
